description: Manual test questions for the baseline vector RAG path. Questions are written to be answerable from typical career/labour-market sources placed under data/raw/ (see data/raw/README.md). Expected evidence is intentionally left empty and MUST be filled in against the documents you actually ingest — do not fabricate it.
how_to_use: Populate data/raw/ with real sources, run scripts/ingest.py and scripts/build_index.py, then ask each question on the Chat page (or via src.copilot.retrieval) and record which retrieved chunks support the answer.

questions.question: What skills are becoming more important for AI-related roles?
What skills and responsibilities are expected of operations managers?
What capabilities distinguish senior leadership roles from mid-level ones?
What evidence is there about rising demand for technological skills?
Which occupations are projected to grow the fastest, and why?
What core competencies are expected of data analysts?
How should a candidate structure answers to behavioural interview questions?
What advice exists for changing careers into a new industry?
Which soft skills are most frequently cited as in demand by employers?
What trends are shaping hiring in the technology sector?
What questions should I expect in an interview for a project management role?
How is automation expected to affect administrative and clerical jobs?
